criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

The PC-tree representation routine normalizes each C-node's cyclic neighbor order to a canonical form (starting at the minimum element and choosing the traversal direction giving the lexicographically smaller neighbor), rather than emitting the raw ring or an arbitrary direction.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: Canonical ordering in represent
